Subject: Prioritized HW allocation matrix + vendor cadence for BluePeak (ACME-923)

Team + OEM,

Quick kickoff: BluePeak verbally confirmed the committed volumes in last week’s SOW discussion and wants a firm provisioning plan for Q1-29. We need a prioritized allocation matrix (which pools get first tranche), a firm OEM cadence, and a cloud backstop proposal to cover lead-time risk.

Key constraints:
- BluePeak target start: 2029-01-08 onboarding window.
- OEM preliminary ETA: still wide (they quoted 14–18 weeks for build + ship).
- BluePeak will accept hybrid: partial dedicated + staged cloud reserve if we can guarantee performance SLAs.

Asks:
1) Karthik — can you draft a prioritized allocation matrix (tranche, SKU, perf target) and note which model variants can be swapped if a sub-sku is delayed? Please attach CSV.
2) OEM ops — need a firm production cadence (milestones, slot confirmations, earliest ship dates). Attach quote and lead-time assumptions.
3) Lauren/Marissa — pricing carveouts and PO timing; what contract terms block us from committing to staged provisioning?

I'll consolidate and share with BluePeak tomorrow EOD.

Thanks,
David

--

Thanks for the summary. Attaching our latest OEM quote (BP_GPU_quote_v3.pdf) with per-SKU pricing and two build lanes (standard / expedited). Notes from our supply team:
- Standard lane lead time: 14 weeks from PO receipt (component availability permitting).
- Expedited lane: ~9 weeks but requires 20% surcharge and limited slot availability.
- We can reserve a soft slot once we receive a signed non-binding intent; firm slot upon 30% deposit.

Attaching allocation matrix and a short procurement runbook. High-level summary:

- Allocation strategy (see CSV attached): tranche A (first 60 nodes) assigned to East US pool (low-latency for BluePeak customers), tranche B (next 40) to West US with shadow caching, tranche C is OEM holdback until performance QA.
- SKU choices: prefer 80A-16GB variant for cost/latency balance; keep 80B as hot-swap option.
- OEM lead-time assumptions: 14–18 weeks if parts stable; add 4 weeks for customs/inspections at high-risk ports.
- Cloud backstop: PrimaCloud reserved hosts for up to 12 weeks at premium; also explored short-term burst from CloudPartnerX (spot-style) but not suitable for SLAs.

Immediate asks / blockers:
1) PO trigger: OEM requires 30% deposit to lock expedited lane — need legal + procurement signoff.
2) Performance clawback: define acceptable perf delta for BluePeak if we serve final 10% from cloud backstop. BluePeak will want <5% degradation.
3) Network pathing: staging network must be ready two weeks prior to onboarding; NetEng to confirm BGP peering windows.

Attachment: allocation_matrix_BP_ACME923.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Action items I’ll take on: populate the SKU swap rules (automated fallback) and run a micro-benchmark across the East pool by next Wed.

-Karthik

- Contract: BluePeak is willing to accept staged provisioning language. Legal will redline a clause that ties tranche acceptance to performance gates (we propose weekly SLAs for the first 8 weeks post-onboard).
- PO timing: procurement needs the finalized allocation CSV + confirmed ship-week ranges to issue a PO. If we choose the expedited lane, expect procurement to request a 30% deposit and Treasury to sign off on escrow language.
- Pricing: Marissa, please confirm whether we can absorb part of the expedited surcharge for launch credits or if we must pass through to BluePeak.

I’ll open a DocuSign PO packet and loop Legal via the shared link below; please review before 09/06 so we can submit to OEM and secure slots.
